source: Game files 19.17020 (techtree.xml tech VillagerAtlanteanToHero <cost>, <researchpoints>7, techtype HeroPromotion; ArchaicAgeAtlantean TechStatus active VillagerAtlanteanToHero; unit_transform.xml VillagerAtlantean -> VillagerAtlanteanHero; proto_unit_commands.xml VillagerAtlanteanToHero <transformselected/>, STR_TRANSFORM_TO_HERO; proto.xml VillagerAtlantean <command>/<transformcommand>, VillagerAtlanteanHero flag UnitTransformFree)
notes: Per unit, from the Archaic Age for every Atlantean god. The promotion is a tech researched on the unit itself: the tech cost is paid when it starts, then 7 s (researchpoints). The hero proto has UnitTransformFree, so the hero's own proto cost (150f 25w 2 favor) is NOT charged. Pop unchanged (2 -> 2). The unit does not work during the 7 s: fan wiki says it is immobile during the transformation (Age of Empires Series Wiki, Atlanteans page; not in the files) -> keepsWorking false, confidence medium. Hero gains: gather rates x~1.10 (Huntable 1.55->1.70, Herdable 1.40->1.53, Farm/WildCrops 1.09->1.19, Wood 1.55->1.70, Gold 1.32->1.45), Build 1.5->1.65, HP 100->125, relic pickup. Theft of Fire (Prometheus; Kronos/Oranos) adds +20% gather and build to Citizen Heroes only. Rheia's Gift (Kronos/Gaia) leaves promotion favor unchanged (x0 then x2 BasePercent). Gaia starts with 2 Citizen Heroes instead of 2 Citizens (see gaia-start-hero-citizens). Already in atlanteans.json as unit.promotion.

notes: Per unit, Archaic+. Oracle Hero: AutoLOS cap 30 (Oracle 25), AutoGatherFavor modifymultiplier 0.80 (Oracle 0.75), speed 4.3 (3.8), HP 105 (90), can attack (9 hack, x6 vs myth) and carry relics. During the promotion the Oracle cannot move (wiki, see citizen-promote-hero); moving also resets the Oracle's LOS growth, so favor dips. With Sons of the Sun (Hyperion; Kronos/Oranos) every Oracle becomes a Hero for free (see sons-of-the-sun-oracle-heroes).

source: Game files 19.17020 (major_gods.xml civ Kronos <timeshifting maxconcurrenttimeshifts=2> protounit costratio/timeratio; proto_unit_commands.xml Unbuild command uiUnbuildSelectedUnit, STR_PUC_UNBUILD; hotkeys/default_keymap.xml Timeshift alt-c doCommandInSelected("Unbuild"), STR_HK_TIMESHIFT; proto.xml buildpoints and costs; Temple flag KeepGarrisonTimeshift; BANG_Documentation Core Data Guide Extended: 'costRatio: Time shifting cost ratio according to building's cost. timeRatio: Time shifting duration ratio according to building's build points.')
notes: Kronos only (no other civ has <timeshifting>). Command on one of the 12 listed own buildings (not Town/Village Center, Sky Passage, walls, Wonder): the building is unbuilt where it stands and rebuilt at the chosen spot. Cost = costRatio x the building's cost, paid on start (error STR_ERROR_UNBUILD_CANT_PAY otherwise); costRatio is assumed to apply to every resource of the cost, favor included. Duration = timeRatio (1.0) x build points, in seconds, no builders involved (guide semantics; not measured). Max 2 concurrent shifts (STR_ERROR_UNBUILD_LIMIT), 3 with Temporal Chaos (Archaic myth tech at the Temple, 100w 50g 10 favor, 20 s), which also halves every shift duration and makes Palace/Towers cost 25%. Temple keeps its garrison (relics). Not in the files (wiki/forum, low confidence): whether the old building keeps training/researching during the shift (the old AoM wiki says queues are cancelled), whether Temporal Scaffolding speeds the shift, the LOS requirement for the new spot. Forum bug reports: a Manor's pop room is re-added when the shift finishes (so pop cap drops while a Manor is shifting), and a shifted Temple counts as the newest Temple for age-up myth unit spawns. Already in gods/kronos.json (timeShift) and powers.json (time-shift).

source: Game files 19.17020 (abilities/abilities.xml skypassage ability SkyPassageDeploy actioncommand 1 notcastable; abilities/atlantean.abilities power SkyPassageDeploy type GeneralEffect placement Skip, STR_ABILITY_SKY_PASSAGE / _LR; proto.xml SkyPassage: cost 25 wood 8 favor, buildpoints 30, HP 500, buildlimit 2, maxcontained 100, contain LogicalTypeGarrisonInShips, notcontain TradeUnit, flags SharedGarrison, DoNotAllowAlliedGarrison, AutoCommandSingleUnit, AutoCommandStartDisabled; techtree.xml ArchaicAgeOranos Enable SkyPassage, Classical/Heroic/MythicAgeOranos BuildLimit +1)
notes: Oranos only. Citizens build Sky Passages (25w 8 favor, 30 bp = 20 s with one Citizen); limit 2 in Archaic, +1 per age (3/4/5). All passages share one garrison (SharedGarrison, up to 100) for Citizens, Oracles, land soldiers, siege and land myth units (not caravans, flyers or Titans). 'Teleport' is a toggle on one passage (off by default, only one passage at a time): everything garrisoned in your passages ungarrisons there, so travel is instant. Teleport cooldown: none in the files (building tooltip says 'This can be done periodically'; wikis give no number) -> unknown, see PENDING. Not a build-order action: the simulator has no map distances; building the passage is a normal build action (sky-passage in atlanteans.json).
